about: Strayed gear that appears in the supply crate. Meshes and textures are read from the player's own Strayed install at run time; nothing from either game ships in the release.

columns.id: stable id used by the other sheets
columns.displayName: name shown on the crate label
columns.strayedMesh: Mesh object name inside Strayed_Data (verify with tools/strayed_index on a real install)
columns.strayedTexture: Texture2D object name inside Strayed_Data (verify the same way)
columns.strayedDamage: damage in Strayed (strayed.wiki.gg/wiki/Tools player damage chart)
columns.acDamage: damage dealt to Animal Company monsters per hit
columns.holdKind: how the item is held: melee | light
columns.lightRange: torch light range in metres, 0 when not a light
columns.verified: true once mesh + texture names were found in a real Strayed install
